npcs.name: MOM
dialogue: Oh, good morning sweetheart! You're up early for once.
ELDER ROWAN was asking about you. You should say hello - he's out by the town sign.
And don't wander into the tall grass without a jacket. It gets chilly!

lines: You flop onto the bed for a moment... You feel refreshed!
There's a nature documentary on TV. Wild creatures roam in distant regions!
Shelves packed with adventure novels. You've read them all twice.
Breakfast is still warm on the table.
